desc:
🌴 Welcome to Empire City. From nothing to empire.

Start with a small apartment and a starter car, then work your way toward the life you want. Choose your career, complete missions, and explore the city with friends.

🚔 Join the police and chase wanted criminals.
💰 Plan robberies and team up for heists.
🚛 Deliver cargo and grow your logistics career.
🏎️ Collect cars, customize your ride, and compete in races.
🏡 Move up to luxury apartments, mansions, and yachts.

Every empire starts somewhere. Build yours.
